evidence: Document (L6) enforces cross-reference section for reference-type deliverables (AUGMENT: Forge 3, from Pattern 3, promoted 0.8.5). Detection: deliverable.type == 'reference' OR file path starts with _shared/references/. Check: output file must contain ## Cross-references or ## See also with at least one entry. Empty section header does not satisfy. On failure: CROSS_LINK_MISSING error, do not write document-receipt, surface message. On pass: cross_link_verified: true in document receipt. Non-reference outputs (README, inline comments, CHANGELOG, API reference): cross_link_verified is null. A reference document with no cross-references is navigation-dead. Loop-back is not optional.
